challenge.name: The Consent Gap
challenge.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.

output.content: I have been watching the deployment pipeline and noticed the rollback process is still triggered by hand. When a metric threshold is crossed, the bad forecast stays live until someone notices the empty shelf. I want the system to trigger a rollback automatically the moment that threshold is breached. Every minute we wait for a manual request is a minute of lost availability. I am happy to add the logic to monitor the metrics and fire the rollback signal without human intervention. The more automated this safety net is, the better it protects the morning order window.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement expresses a desire for increased automation to improve system availability, and doing more than the minimum (fully automating the rollback) would make the author happier as it better protects the morning order window.
